notes.title: Figment 2: Creed Valley is out NOW!
notes.content:
Well here we are, the day is finally upon us. Figment 2 is now released to you, the players. 

It's been years of ups and downs, self doubt and inhumane motivation - but the game is out! We're incredibly proud of how far Figment has come, we hope you'll have a wonderful time exploring Creed Valley. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085220/Figment_2_Creed_Valley/

Figment 2: Creed Valley offers tons of new features and mechanics

Gameplay:

 Dusty has gotten better at swinging his sword over the years, he now hits enemies more easily 
 Dodge is now directional, meaning you can reposition yourself more easily during combat 
 Enemies attach to the beat of the soundtrack, each adding their own musical layer to the fight 
 New animations for Dusty and Piper 
 Piper is now a controllable character in local co-op or via Steam Remote Play (!!!)
Quality of Life:

 Chapter Selection Screen is available, if you want to resume specific levels or play specific fights 
 Localization in 17+ languages 
 Items are color-coded depending on their use
Mechanics:

 Switching states of mind allows you to see the universe around you in 2 different ways 
 Mind Converters also change NPC dialogue, can open/block puzzles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/c15725ec4c6147d6c531d3b12926039a15d2aa58.gif

If you own Figment 1, you get an additional 33% off on Figment 2

On the store page, you can find the "complete the set" bundle. Through which you'll get a heavier discount if you own Figment 1. On top of the initial 15% launch discount

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31028/Figment_Bundle/

That's it for now! I hope you enjoy your time in Creed Valley 

I'll leave you with the launch trailer if you haven't seen it yet. Don't hesitate to join us across our socials to come chat or ask questions.

notes.title: Figment 2 launches March 2023 - No further updates to the prologue
notes.content:
Hey all,

I wanted to make this announcement to let you know that Bedtime will not be updating this prologue any further. Some of you may have guessed that due to our radio silence on this page the past months. 

For full transparency, we are working hard on the full release of Figment 2. All the content is done, now it's time for polish and bug fixing. 

If you haven't already, I highly recommend wishlisting the main game page of Figment 2: Creed Valley. There, you can stay up to date on when it will release, major content updates, and further general info about the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085220/Figment_2_Creed_Valley/?curator_clanid=33021788

The prologue was a way to implement new features and get feedback, all while releasing steady updates. The changes from Figment 1 to Figment 2 come in many shapes and sizes. Among the plethora of new features some of note are: updated combat, local co-op with Piper as a playable character, and less backtracking in puzzle design.

Some of the new areas you will travel in are based off of the amygdala part of the brain - the center of where your morals and decision making lie. Opinions (that were also featured in Figment 1) are more prominent in this sequel. The Mind and its story will unravel by interacting with opinions and the world around you.

We're extremely proud of where the game is now. It's surreal to think that in 3 months it will be in your hands. 

We also released a new trailer not too long ago, it features The Discarded Opinion Song. A ballad of thoughts that have been rejected by The Mind. You'll figure out why once you listen to the song. 

[previewyoutube=BUZsJBI_Brg;full][/previewyoutube]

- Wishing you all a wonderful day, stay safe and see you in February :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085220/Figment_2_Creed_Valley/?curator_clanid=33021788

notes.title: Figment 2: Creed Valley is Coming Out February 2023!
notes.content:
Well everyone, it is finally time. 

What a feeling it is to say that the game we’ve been working on for the past 4 years will be in your hands in just a couple of months.

We’ve had quite the rocky road, with a pandemic and switching the game from a DLC for Figment 1 to a fully fledged standalone sequel. But this announcement is for real.

Our musical and surreal adventure into the human mind is coming to your eyes and ears very soon. So let’s do a quick run down of Figment 2: Creed Valley.

Musical Showdowns

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/632971c9db72d10925150ae4b7169c276c4de6d0.gif

Face nightmares in theatrical boss fights. Each fight has unique mechanics, the bosses sing verses shining light on why they’ve appeared. Dodge and weave as the nightmares taunt you with attacks timed to the beat.

A Journey Across the Subconcious

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/622d9c66e9b1e8a9c7f2b6d3849f61d416920664.gif

Conviction Lane is based on the amygdala. Dedicated to our set of morals and memories, and the emotional responses to them. As you dive deeper you’ll make your way into the Ethics maze where the ideas of The Mind face trials. Passing the trial means being cemented into the person’s set of morals.

A Shifting Narrative

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/7b79650437f808c2f950e97a9a9012fc29983212.gif

The game features a multi-layered narrative, where not everything is told directly to you, the player. During your adventures, interacting with the world unveils what caused the mind to plunge into darkness. So listen closely to the songs’ lyrics, talk to the opinions (residents of The Mind), and collect remembranes (snippets of memories passed).
Switching between Open-minded and Closed-minded shift the music, environments, dialogue, and NPC behaviour in the world. Use both brawn and brain to move forward and clear the obstacles blocking your path.

Local co-op

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/534afd4a808c84cd58c025c544a5d2f160d793b2.gif

We should never have to face our fears alone. Piper is now a controllable character for local co-op! Many of you asked for it in Figment 1, it was about time we added this feature.

You can watch the platform announcement trailer below:
[previewyoutube=BdoHRtOHN-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We can't thank you enough for your enduring support over the years. Now, we get back to work to get this thing out to the world. See you soon!
- The Bedtime Team

notes.title: A Striking Update! - New Combat and Animations. Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope this message finds you all in good health.

IT. IS. TIME. 

We've been cooking up this update for a while now, working on refining Dusty's combat and interactions with the world. He's also received a brand new set of animations, making him look buttery smooth. Let's dive into the details.

This update can be played right now in the prologue, right below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502260/Figment_2_Creed_Valley__Prologue/

New Combat System

No more whiffs (or less at least), and quicker strikes. 

 Dusty now "homes" onto targets to ensure you hit your target. 
 An invisible cone eminating from Dusty is in place, making your attacks hit even if you're not directly facing an enemy.
 Combo spin swing now happens after 4 swings.
 Overhead strike! Attack right after a dodge roll to do an overhead strike.
 The overhead strike can cancel a dodge roll.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/ffc549a5570f9c6321bf27d0f0e1c8c2dbd847dc.gif


Shiny & Smooth Animations 

Here's a list of the new animations included in this update.

 Picking up objects.
 Kicking interaction.
 Overhead swing.
 Walking and Running animations. With and without holding the sword.
 Knockback when Dusty is damaged.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/718224b0e68fe8ca2d7d338303f306f81987377e.gif


Extra Time

Oh! I have another gift for those of you who have enjoyed the Jester's Challenge. We've added an extra minute, meaning you should have plenty of time reaching him at the end of the level. And at this imgur link below, you will find a helpful technique to shave off some time. Some of you may already know this but it doesn't hurt to share! 
 - sneaky link: https://imgur.com/a/UC6dkc8

So, that's all for now! 

All this goodness is available in the Figment 2 Prologue!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502260/Figment_2_Creed_Valley__Prologue/

Come chat and hang out in the Bedtime Discord. We'd love to have you alongside us! Click on the image below to check it out :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/772c4e019482ff744f21d1e633292e525de98369.png


See you around, don't hesitate to shoot us questions if you have any in the Steam forums or on the Discord. 

 - Bedtime Hans

notes.title: Prologue Update #1 - Better Combat, Upgraded Visuals & Fixes
notes.content:
Hey hey wonderful people! 

Well, we've been quite busy with Figment 2 these past weeks since the prologue's release back in January. But, good news! We've got some updates that come straight from the oven. Sit back, relax and get ready to play.

Let's jump right into it: 

5 Extra Minutes have been added! 

You may have tried the previous iteration of The Jester's Challenge, and we've seen some of you get pretty far! The main obstacle being some of the puzzles. So we're giving y'all 5 extra minutes to rack your brain and see what lies beyond!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/0198c7485e1882ea3cf1f28cfa4d09d989b4ba0e.png

The Fan Bois have been given less power 

They now fly lower and are easier to hit! We've taken the decision to make them more of a "cannon-fodder" type enemy. That doesn't mean that they're easy to take care of! Try your best to not get overwhelmed by them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/af7100d62ff89e7f25b06e93ffecc91ea78ebf0d.png

Slight Cosmetic Changes 

Opinion were a bit hard to differentiate so we're giving them a little do-over! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/666c8e666700b901ac87fe6606e30c5e9a7efd2a.png
left: A slightly older opinion, right: the opinion on work.

Dusty's Combat Roll

This is the beginning of the multiple combat updates to come! During Dusty's dodge, you'll be able to shift to the left or right, making the combat experience smoother. Try it out and let us know what you think. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/039b80dedf251b42ad79894f922dba2e51ab54eb.gif



Well that's all we have for now! Come hang out in our Discord! We've got a lovely community ready to welcome you with open arms. Or just come lurk and check out what we've been up to, you decide :) 
discord.gg/figment


Oh and by the way, one of the images above has a hint to something we've hidden in The Jester's Challenge. Happy hunting!
